svg.title: Four gates on a credit card travel medical certificate
svg.desc: Age, trip length, stability, and the pay-with-card rule all have to pass. A large medical maximum does not open a closed gate. No card is named.
svg.text: All four gates, from the PDF
No card names. No rankings. The certificate you hold is the only source. 24 Sep 2026.
A closed gate means the medical maximum is irrelevant for that trip.
Short, healthy, under the age line, fare rule met: the certificate can be the policy.
Snowbird length, unstable condition, or a birthday the PDF excludes: buy standalone coverage.
Primary versus excess is a fifth read. Maximums do not automatically add.
Provincial daily caps are not this certificate. They are on the provincial travel-medical guide.
Education only. Not a card recommendation.
